title: XmartAgro frontend data
description: Static data for the XmartAgro panel in the shape of its API contract (summary, inputs, scenarios): one exploratory analysis at one NASA POWER point. Text fields are {key, en, es}. Nothing here is a forecast, a yield prediction or a recommendation. Every field has `x-used-in`: where the panel shows it.
x-used-in: The whole document: one file the panel reads, with no API call

text.description: A text in both languages. Show `en` or `es`; `key` is a stable id of the sentence in the label catalog.

season_counts.description: Number of historical seasons (or crop-years of a rotation) in each deficit class. A season is classed by the share of the crop's water demand left unmet in its critical stage: low below 10 %, moderate from 10 % to 30 %, high from 30 % (provisional team convention).

ok.description: Drops of low deficit: the water was enough (legend «tuvo agua»).

out.description: Drops of high deficit: the water ran short (legend «sin agua»).

drops.description: The same counts split into ten parts by largest remainder: one drop each, light to dark. It is a share of historical seasons, not a probability.

state.description: good, fair or poor; null while there is no diagnosis.

trend.description: improving, stable or declining; null while there is no diagnosis.

precision.description: How precise the estimate is: always `low` for now.

items.description: A reason for the soil state.

missing.description: What is missing, for the line «Estimación de precisión baja: falta …».

id.description: Stable id, e.g. survey_03 or barley@06-10.

name.description: Name of the option, e.g. «Rotación observada 3».

is_current.description: True for the crop the producer has sown now: «Tu rotación actual», red outline.

water_risk.description: low, medium or high, from the number of high-deficit drops (provisional thresholds); null when nothing was simulated.

soil_effect.description: improves, stays or worsens; always null: the model does not estimate it.

soil_reason.description: Why the soil effect; always null.

evidence.description: Evidence for the option; empty for now.

gaps.description: What the evaluation does not cover (fixed cycle length, far sowing date...).

detail.description: The exact counts as a sentence, e.g. «104 de 280 combinaciones año-zafra con déficit alto».
